title: Geometric realization of a finite-type graded module on the base-changed scheme
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $B=\bigoplus_{k\ge0}B_k$ a commutative graded $A$-algebra (the $B_k$ are $A$-submodules with $B_kB_l\subseteq B_{k+l}$ and $1\in B_0$, the structure map $A\to B$ landing in $B_0$) which is a finite type $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and write $f^\sharp(a)\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ for the image of $a\in A$. Let $(\mathcal G_m)_{m\ge0}$ be quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], and for all $k,m\ge0$ and $b\in B_k$ let $\mu^{(m)}_b:\mathcal G_m\to\mathcal G_{m+k}$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], such that: (i) $\mu^{(m)}_{b+b'}=\mu^{(m)}_b+\mu^{(m)}_{b'}$ for $b,b'\in B_k$; (ii) $\mu^{(m+l)}_b\circ\mu^{(m)}_{b'}=\mu^{(m)}_{bb'}$ for $b\in B_k$, $b'\in B_l$; (iii) for $a\in A$ with image $a\cdot1\in B_0$, $\mu^{(m)}_{a\cdot1}$ is multiplication by $f^\sharp(a)$ on $\mathcal G_m$; (iv) (finite type) $X$ is covered by open sets $U$ for each of which there are finitely many integers $d_1,\dots,d_r\ge0$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal G_{d_i}(U)$ such that for every $m\ge0$, every open $V\subseteq U$ and every $t\in\mathcal G_m(V)$, each point of $V$ has an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq V$ on which $t|_W=\sum_{i:\,d_i\le m}\sum_jc_{ij}\,\mu^{(d_i)}_{b_{ij}}(s_i)|_W$ for finitely many $c_{ij}\in\mathcal O_X(W)$ and $b_{ij}\in B_{m-d_i}$. (These data are the same as a quasi-coherent graded module $\bigoplus_m\mathcal G_m$ of finite type over the graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra $f^*\widetilde B$, $b\in B_k$ acting through its pulled-back global section.) Put $g=\operatorname{Spec}(A\to B)$, $Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec} A}\operatorname{Spec} B$, $\pi:Y\to X$ and $f_B:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} B$. There exists a quasi-coherent finitely presented $\mathcal O_Y$-module $F$ and maps $\iota_m:G_m\to\pi_*F$ making $\pi_*F$ a coproduct of the $G_m$ in $\mathcal O_X$-modules. For every $b\in B_k$, $\mu^{(m)}_b$ followed by $\iota_{m+k}$ equals $\iota_m$ followed by the pushforward of multiplication by $f_B^\sharp(b)$ on $F$. This statement contains no cohomology conclusion.

proof.text: On an affine open Spec C of X, extend the homogeneous action by finite sums to sum_m G_m(U) over C tensor_A B. The internal grading makes the extension unique. hmu_add, hmu_mul and hmu_scalar give additivity, multiplication and unit. Quasi-coherence and localization of direct sums make restrictions compatible, giving a quasi-coherent module over the pulled-back algebra sheaf.

Relative-spec base change identifies the relative spectrum of the pulled-back algebra sheaf with Y. The affine module correspondence realizes the constructed algebra module as pi_*F. The homogeneous coproduct inclusions iota have the coproduct universal property after restriction of scalars. Multiplication by fB^sharp(b) on F restricts on the degree-m inclusion to mu m k b, proving the displayed square.

The local generators in hfinite generate the algebra module: homogeneous sections are locally in their span and a section of a sheaf coproduct is locally a finite sum of homogeneous sections. The affine finite-type correspondence makes F finite type. B is Noetherian and Y locally Noetherian by proper base change and finite type. Quasi-coherent finite-type modules on a locally Noetherian scheme are coherent, hence finitely presented: on affine opens finite modules over Noetherian rings have finitely generated relation modules, and these finite presentations cover Y.

lean.statement:
theorem gradedModule_relativeSpec_realization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra.FiniteType A B]
    (graded : ℕ → Submodule A B)
    (hgrading : DirectSum.IsInternal graded)
    (hunit : (1 : B) ∈ graded 0)
    (hmul : ∀ (k l : ℕ) {x y : B}, x ∈ graded k → y ∈ graded l → x * y ∈ graded (k + l))
    (hscalar : ∀ (a : A), algebraMap A B a ∈ graded 0)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f]
    (G : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (hG : ∀ m : ℕ, (G m).IsQuasicoherent)
    (mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k)))
    (hmu_add : ∀ (m k : ℕ) (b b' : graded k),
      mu m k (b + b') = mu m k b + mu m k b')
    (hmu_mul : ∀ (m k l : ℕ) (b : graded k) (b' : graded l),
      HEq (mu m l b' ≫ mu (m + l) k b)
        (mu m (k + l) ⟨b.val * b'.val, hmul k l b.property b'.property⟩))
    (hmu_scalar : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A) (U : X.Opens)
      (t : (G m).val.obj (op U)),
      HEq ((mu m 0 ⟨algebraMap A B a, hscalar a⟩).val.app (op U) t)
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom
          (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a) • t))
    (hfinite : ∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℕ) (s : ∀ i : Fin r, (G (d i)).val.obj (op U)),
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (t : (G m).val.obj (op V))
          (y : X), y ∈ V → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
            (G m).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op t ∈
              Submodule.span ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op W))
                {z | ∃ (i : Fin r), d i ≤ m ∧
                  ∃ b : graded (m - d i),
                    HEq z ((mu (d i) (m - d i) b).val.app (op W)
                      ((G (d i)).val.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op (s i)))})
    :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    ∃ (F : Y.Modules), F.IsQuasicoherent ∧ F.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      ∃ (iota : ∀ m : ℕ, G m ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F) iota)) ∧
          ∀ (k m : ℕ) (b : graded k),
            mu m k b ≫ iota (m + k) = iota m ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).map
                (F.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b.val))
